---
title: "`r params$title`"
report-class: scenario
output:
  html_document:
    self_contained: true
    md_extensions: "-native_divs-native_spans"
  pdf_document:
    latex_engine: xelatex
  word_document: default
params:
  title:         "Scenario summary"
  scen_name:     ""
  scen_desc:     ""
  image_file:    NULL
  logos:         NULL
  badges:        NULL
  status_df:     NULL
  gen_plot:      NULL
  cost_total_df: NULL
  emis_total_df: NULL
  runs_df:       NULL
header-includes:
  - \usepackage{booktabs}
---

```{r en-setup, include=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)

# One-page glimpse of a solved scenario: status/objective, the (lumped)
# generation mix, cost and emission totals, and the run list. Everything
# else -- maps, calendars, breakdowns, checks -- lives in the standard and
# full scenario templates; none of it is built for this one.
fmt <- energyRt::report_setup()
tbl <- function(df, caption = NULL, digits = 4L, ...)
  energyRt::report_tbl(df, caption, digits, output = fmt, ...)
emit_img <- function(path, frac = 1)
  energyRt::report_img(path, frac, output = fmt)
```

```{r en-css, results='asis'}
energyRt::report_css(fmt)
```

```{r en-logo, results='asis'}
if (length(params$logos) > 0) {
  energyRt::report_img_row(params$logos, frac_total = 0.9, output = fmt)
} else if (!is.null(params$image_file)) {
  emit_img(params$image_file, 0.25)
}
if (length(params$badges) > 0) {
  energyRt::report_img_row(params$badges,
                           frac_total = min(0.9, 0.08 * length(params$badges)),
                           output = fmt)
}
```

`r if (isTRUE(nzchar(params$scen_desc))) params$scen_desc`

## Overview

```{r en-status, results='asis'}
tbl(params$status_df)
```

```{r en-gen, fig.width=8, fig.height=5.5, eval=!is.null(params$gen_plot)}
params$gen_plot
```

```{r en-cost-total, results='asis', eval=!is.null(params$cost_total_df)}
tbl(params$cost_total_df, caption = "Costs (total over the horizon)")
```

```{r en-emis-total, results='asis', eval=!is.null(params$emis_total_df)}
tbl(params$emis_total_df, caption = "Emissions (total over the horizon)")
```

```{r en-runs-header, results='asis', eval=!is.null(params$runs_df) && nrow(params$runs_df) > 0}
cat("## Runs\n")
```

```{r en-runs, results='asis', eval=!is.null(params$runs_df) && nrow(params$runs_df) > 0}
tbl(params$runs_df, max_rows = 10)
```
